mentions.name: Lumi AI
mentions.description: This Shopify app automates product content generation for stores, producing descriptions, SEO titles, meta tags, and alt text. It uses Vision AI to analyze product images directly, generating accurate, context-aware, accessible alt text (WCAG 2.1 AA compliant) and detailed descriptions based on what the product actually looks like. To avoid a generic AI feel, it crawls existing store content to build a custom brand voice profile that matches the store's established tone. It also supports bulk processing of up to 500 products per batch with real-time tracking, and offers a free tier with 20 credits per month.
mentions.problem: The quality of automated content for large e-commerce catalogs: existing tools just spin existing keywords and produce generic output, and stores need accurate, accessible alt text and descriptions based on what products actually look like.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Lumi AI (https://apps.shopify.com/lumi-ai-seo-alt-text), a Shopify app that automates product content generation (descriptions, SEO titles, meta tags, and alt text).
